card.name: Verb just before "recommended"
card.fires_on: The linking verb or adverb (is, are, strongly, not) that comes right before "recommended" or "encouraged" in drug-label advice sentences. It follows a subject such as a test, a filter, or gloves.

modes.label: is/are before recommended
modes.description: The verb "is" or "are" after a subject noun phrase, just before "recommended".
modes.example: The use of gloves<< is>> recommended.

modes.label: strongly/not before recommended
modes.description: An adverb such as "strongly" or "not" that sits between the verb and "recommended" or "encouraged".
modes.example: Healthcare providers are<< strongly>> encouraged to do all of the following:

card.writes: It pushes the model to output "recommended" or "requested" next, and it suppresses Chinese phrases of advice.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the label says something is recommended.
